# AAPF vendored toolchain
#
# Why this exists: both sandboxes used to fetch Chocolatey, ffmpeg, Python and
# Impacket from the internet during provisioning. That made a recorded run
# depend on three external services staying up and unchanged, and it broke
# outright whenever the host VMware NAT service died (2026-09-17). These files
# are the exact artifacts the recorded runs used.
#
# Assembled: 2026-09-17

python-3.14.7-amd64.exe
    https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.14.7/python-3.14.7-amd64.exe
ffmpeg.exe   (ffmpeg 9.0.1-essentials_build, bin/ffmpeg.exe from the archive)
    https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip
wheels/      (pip download "impacket==0.13.1" --only-binary=:all:
              --platform win_amd64 --python-version 3.14)
